H7725: to turn back (hence, away) transitively or intransitively, literally or figuratively (not necessarily with the idea of return to the starting point); generally to retreat; often adverbial, again
H5375: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative
H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H5774: to fly; also (by implication of dimness) to faint (from the darkness of swooning)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H520: properly, a mother (i.e. unit of measure, or the fore-arm (below the elbow), i.e. a cubit; also a door-base (as a bond of the entrance)
H6235: ten (as an accumulation to the extent of the digits)
H3318: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H1589: to thieve (literally or figuratively); by implication, to deceive
H2088: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
H3644: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately as, thus, so
H5352: to be (or make) clean (literally or figuratively); by implication (in an adverse sense) to be bare, i.e. extirpated
H7650: to seven oneself, i.e. swear (as if by repeating a declaration seven times)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H6635: a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized forwar (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship)
H935: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H8267: an untruth; by implication, a sham (often adverbial)
H3885: to stop (usually over night); by implication, to stay permanently; hence (in a bad sense) to be obstinate (especially in words, to complain)
H8432: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre
H3615: to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitived (to complete, prepare, consume)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H6086: a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks)
H4397: a messenger; specifically, of God, i.e. an angel (also a prophet, priest or teacher)
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H4994: 'I pray', 'now', or 'then'; added mostly to verbs (in the Imperative or Future), or to interjections, occasionally to an adverb or conjunction
H1931: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
H374: an ephah or measure for grain; hence, a measure in general
H3603: a circle, i.e. (by implication) a circumjacent tract or region, especially the Ghor or valley of the Jordan; also a (round) loaf; also a talent (or large [round] coin)
H259: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H7993: to throw out, down or away (literally or figuratively)

H3671: an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bedclothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle
H2007: themselves (often used emphatic for the copula, also in indirect relation)
H2624: the kind (maternal) bird, i.e. a stork
H996: between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H575: where?; hence, whither?, when?; also hither and thither
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H3559: properly, to be erect (i.e. stand perpendicular); hence (causatively) to set up, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (establish, fix, prepare, apply), or figurative (appoint, render sure, proper or prosperous)
H3240: to deposit; by implication, to allow to stay
H8033: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
